faq1.q: How long does a claim take to process?
faq1.a: Most claims are reviewed within 3–5 business days. Motor and property claims may take longer if a site visit is required.

faq2.q: What documents do I need to submit a claim?
faq2.a: A completed claim form, photos of the damage or incident, and any supporting invoices or police reports if applicable.

faq3.q: How do I renew a policy?
faq3.a: Renewals are handled by your broker. You will receive a reminder before expiry — contact your broker to confirm renewal terms.
